165: Participation in a camp is always at your own risk. Every participant must wear a helmet and sturdy shoes; protectors are optional. Each rider is responsible for the technical condition of their own bike. Please inform the instructors in advance about any health issues. The briefing includes a short safety talk. First aid will be within driving distance of the camp, or a medic will be present on site.
